layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a large thin red-bordered rectangle that frames the whole slide content. Below the title, a horizontal left-to-right flowchart pipeline occupies the middle band: an ellipse 'Training Data' at top-left, a light-blue label 'End-To-End model' at top-center, four process boxes inside a dashed red rounded container, and a 'Classifier Output' box at the right. A solid red curved arrow runs from the bottom of the 'Training Data' ellipse into the left side of the 'Pre processing' box, and a dashed navy curved double-headed arrow arcs from Training Data across to Classifier Output. Beneath the pipeline, a red double-headed arrow spanning the pipeline width (~x 12-76%) carries the label 'Deeeeeeep Model'. Below that, a row of five annotation callouts (four gray rectangles + one yellow starburst) sits under the arrow. A two-line red-text statement box is centered at the bottom. A solid black strip runs along the very bottom edge of the slide (video artifact).

layout.hierarchy: Visually dominant: the red title, then the four-box pipeline (the dark-red 'Classification' box is the strongest single fill), then the tan Training Data ellipse and Classifier Output box. Secondary: the red double-headed 'Deeeeeeep Model' arrow. Tertiary: the small gray annotation boxes and the bottom red-text statement box. The dashed navy arc reads as a connective overlay across the top.

visual_elements.description: Horizontal 4-stage pipeline inside a dashed red rounded-rectangle container. Nodes left to right: (1) 'Pre processing' - rectangle, pale-yellow fill, blue border, black bold text on two lines 'Pre'/'processing'; (2) 'Feature Extraction' - rectangle, pale-blue fill, blue border, black bold text 'Feature'/'Extraction'; (3) 'Feature Selection' - rectangle, pale-green fill, green border, black bold text 'Feature'/'Selection'; (4) 'Classification' - rectangle, dark-red fill, white bold text 'Classification'. Solid red arrows connect each node left-to-right. A solid red arrow exits 'Classification' rightward into 'Classifier Output' - a tan/brown rectangle with black bold text, placed OUTSIDE the dashed container. A curved solid red arrow leads from the bottom of the 'Training Data' ellipse (top-left, tan/peach fill, black bold two-line text) down and right into the left side of 'Pre processing'.

Long dashed navy-blue curved double-headed arrow: left arrowhead points at the right edge of the 'Training Data' ellipse; the dashed line arcs right, passing beneath the 'End-To-End model' label, then curves down with the right arrowhead pointing into the top of the 'Classifier Output' box. It visually ties Training Data to Classifier Output as the 'End-To-End model' path.

visual_elements.description: Label chip 'End-To-End model': small rounded rectangle, pale-blue fill, medium-blue outline, bold black text, centered above the pipeline.

Red double-headed horizontal arrow spanning the width of the deep-model pipeline (from below 'Pre processing' to below 'Classification'), with a pale-green rounded-rectangle label 'Deeeeeeep Model' sitting centered on the arrow line. A small black mouse cursor arrow overlaps the label's right end (video artifact).

Row of five annotation callouts aligned under the pipeline: (1) gray rectangle, two lines: 'Based on Training Data' (black) / '(Model Choice)' (red); (2) gray rectangle, three lines: 'Model choose Best' (red) / 'feature for given' (black) / 'training data' (black); (3) gray rectangle, three lines: 'Model Reduces' (red) / 'the features' (black) / '(if required)' (black); (4) gray rectangle, two lines: 'Classify using' / 'Trained Model' (both black); (5) yellow multi-point starburst/explosion shape with red bold text on two lines: 'Based on' / 'Trained Model', positioned at far right under 'Classifier Output'.
Bottom statement box: white-filled rectangle with medium-blue border containing two centered lines of bold red text: 'No Interaction from Human' / 'It is Based on Training Data'.

Large thin-red-outline rectangle (no fill) framing all slide content; plus a solid black full-width strip along the very bottom edge of the slide (video letterbox/progress-bar artifact, not part of the slide design).

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title is the largest text (~32-36pt), bold, red, title case. All shape labels are bold (~14-16pt), black except 'Classification' which is bold white on dark red. Annotation callouts are smaller (~11-12pt); within them, key phrases ('(Model Choice)', 'Model choose Best', 'Model Reduces', and all of 'Based on Trained Model') are bold red while the rest is black. The bottom statement box uses bold red text on two lines. No italics, no all-caps, no numbered bullets. Multi-line labels are center-aligned within their shapes.

recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to plain white (#FFFFFF).
2. Frame: draw a no-fill rectangle with a thin red (#CC0000) outline spanning x 7-94%, y 7-87%; every element below sits inside it.
3. Title: centered text 'The Complete Deep Learning Model' at x 22-70%, y 11-17%, bold sans-serif ~32-36pt, red #C00000, title case.
4. Training Data ellipse: oval at x 8-21%, y 23-33%, fill tan/peach #F5CBA7, thin black #000000 outline, centered bold black two-line text 'Training' / 'Data' (~14-16pt).
5. End-To-End model chip: rounded rectangle at x 36-58%, y 24-29%, fill pale blue #CCE6FF, outline #3366CC, centered bold black text 'End-To-End model' (~14-16pt).
6. Pipeline container: rounded rectangle, no fill, dashed red #CC0000 outline, spanning x 12-76%, y 36-50%.
7. Pre processing box: leftmost of four equal rectangles evenly spaced inside the container (band y ~38-48%); fill pale yellow #FFFFCC, border blue #0000CC, centered bold black two-line text 'Pre' / 'processing'.
8. Feature Extraction box: second rectangle; fill pale blue #CCE6FF, border blue #0000CC, centered bold black two-line text 'Feature' / 'Extraction'.
9. Feature Selection box: third rectangle; fill pale green #CCFFCC, border green #009933, centered bold black two-line text 'Feature' / 'Selection'.
10. Classification box: fourth rectangle; fill dark red #990000, border #990000 (exact shade not captured), centered bold white text 'Classification'.
11. Arrow: solid red #CC0000 right-pointing arrow from the right edge of 'Pre processing' to the left edge of 'Feature Extraction'.
12. Arrow: solid red #CC0000 right-pointing arrow from 'Feature Extraction' to 'Feature Selection'.
13. Arrow: solid red #CC0000 right-pointing arrow from 'Feature Selection' to 'Classification'.
14. Classifier Output box: rectangle at x 77-90%, y 37-49%, outside the dashed container; fill tan/brown #C8A165, thin black #000000 outline (reconstructed), centered bold black text 'Classifier Output'.
15. Arrow: solid red #CC0000 right-pointing arrow from the right edge of 'Classification' to the left edge of 'Classifier Output'.
16. Arrow: solid red #CC0000 curved arrow from the bottom of the 'Training Data' ellipse curving down-right into the left side of 'Pre processing'.
17. Arrow: dashed navy #00008B curved double-headed arrow - left arrowhead at the right edge of the 'Training Data' ellipse (~x 21%, y 28%), arcing right beneath the 'End-To-End model' chip, right arrowhead pointing down into the top of 'Classifier Output' (~x 84%, y 37%).
18. Arrow: solid red #CC0000 horizontal double-headed arrow spanning x 12-76%, y 52-56%.
19. Deeeeeeep Model label: pale green #CCFFCC rounded rectangle with bold black text 'Deeeeeeep Model', centered on the midpoint of the step-18 arrow.
20. Callout 1: gray #D9D9D9 rectangle, leftmost of four evenly spaced across ~x 9-76%, y 58-68%; centered ~11-12pt text - line 1 'Based on Training Data' (black), line 2 '(Model Choice)' (bold red #CC0000).
21. Callout 2: gray #D9D9D9 rectangle, second position; line 1 'Model choose Best' (bold red #CC0000), line 2 'feature for given' (black), line 3 'training data' (black).
22. Callout 3: gray #D9D9D9 rectangle, third position; line 1 'Model Reduces' (bold red #CC0000), line 2 'the features' (black), line 3 '(if required)' (black).
23. Callout 4: gray #D9D9D9 rectangle, fourth position; line 1 'Classify using' (black), line 2 'Trained Model' (black).
24. Starburst: yellow #FFFF99 multi-point starburst/explosion shape at the far right of the callout row (~x 77-93%, y 58-68%, under 'Classifier Output'); bold red #CC0000 two-line text 'Based on' / 'Trained Model'.
25. Statement box: white #FFFFFF rectangle with blue #3366CC border at x 29-60%, y 73-82%; two centered bold red #CC0000 lines - 'No Interaction from Human' / 'It is Based on Training Data'.
26. Optional artifact only: a solid black #000000 strip across the full slide width at y 95-100% replicates the video letterbox - omit it for a clean slide; also omit the black mouse cursor artifact near the 'Deeeeeeep Model' label.
